notes: Matching per prompt_align.md (strict). Kela caseworker and Kela system are treated as the same actor; match_type_note records where they differ. Counterpart actors (landlord vs Kela) are not normally matched; G11 is the one exception, marked partial, because the only lease-data node is the landlord's electronic transfer itself. Nodes split by channel/outcome are 'partial'; nodes bundling several reference steps are 'merged'. Evidence text in the generated map was ignored. order_checks: (predecessor, step) pairs from the reference predecessor lists in reference order where both are matched, skipping pairs whose matched node sets share a node, first 60 taken. For each pair the shortest directed path (edge count) is taken over all matched-node combinations in each direction; same_order is true only if a forward path exists and is no longer than the shortest reverse path, false if only a shorter reverse path exists, not_connected if neither exists. The map has loop-back edges (to N47, N48, N88, N13, N22, N57/N58, N82), so reverse paths often exist; forward_len and reverse_len are given per pair.
